This field previously read F.A. 473, marked inferred-medium, on the reading that no annal dates the Easterlings' ARRIVAL and 473 is inferred from the Nirnaeth being 472 — but §252 dates the SENDING, which is what this sentence says, and the archive's own easterlingsfa record had cited it all along.
